description: Change a project's details (the Studio's Details tab): title, logline, description, project type, format, stage, country and city or remote-friendly, shoot dates or dates flexible, links, previous work (the user's own published films, by public id) and its visibility (public or private · invite only). Only the fields given change. Validation and messages are the Studio's own; making a live project public re-runs the publish checklist.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the shoot, e.g. GB, US; null clears it.

dates_flexible.description: Whether the dates are still flexible (satisfies the dates checklist item on its own).

description.description: The story, the plan, what working on it is like; null clears it.

format.description: short, feature, documentary, series, music_video, commercial, student or other; null clears it.

links.description: Links shown on the project page (label + URL, up to 4). Replaces the whole list; an empty list clears it.

logline.description: One or two sentences that sell it; null clears it.

previous_work_film_ids.description: Previous work shown on the project page: public film ids of the user's own published films (get_project lists the options), in display order, up to 6. Replaces the whole list.

project_id.description: The project's id (from list_projects or create_project).

project_type.description: paid (Paid job), self_funded (Self-funded) or passion (Passion project).

remote_friendly.description: Whether people can work on it remotely (satisfies the location checklist item on its own).

shoot_end.description: Last shoot day as YYYY-MM-DD; null clears it.

shoot_start.description: First shoot day as YYYY-MM-DD; null clears it.

stage.description: development, pre_production, production or post_production; null clears it.

visibility.description: public (listed on Projects and Jobs, open to everyone) or private (invite only: reachable only by the people the owner invites from the Studio).

name: update_project
title: Update project
